correctness.rationale: Exact basis and cycle rank, averaging over weighted graph automorphisms, one-parameter invariant projections, weighted ℓ1 column norm formula, and complete piecewise minimization prove the claim for all integer m≥2, all real 0<t≤2. Boundaries and equality at m(2−t)=4 are proved, not inferred from finite tests; exact code runs 112 cases, optional full nonsymmetric numerical LP runs 20 cases.

value.rationale: A concrete infinite two-parameter structural family determines the least complementing operator norm of a shared-edge cycle space, with a sharp transition and saturation beyond four pages. This answers a naturally motivated cycle-space complementability problem in the standard transportation-cost quotient realization; the cycles share an edge, preventing a trivial direct sum over independent cycles.
